note: Where the crew is, and what that means for asking the ground for help. Nothing here changes the physiology engine. delaySec is the one-way signal delay [min, max]. Moon: 384,400 km mean distance at the speed of light is 1.28 s. Mars: 54.6 million km (closest) to 401 million km (farthest) gives about 3 to 22 minutes (NASA and secondary sources; the exact value depends on orbital geometry). Station: NASA states data via the TDRS relay satellites arrives in under a second; 0.25 to 0.5 s is our estimate of the one-way delay and is not a NASA figure. gravityG: Moon surface 1.62 m/s2 = 0.165 g; Mars surface 3.7 m/s2 = about 0.38 g; orbits and transits are weightless (about 0 g). 'live' means a ground reply arrives in seconds, 'delayed' means the crew must act first.
